title: Great way to see parts of the city with young artists!
text: We had a great time making the postcards! My daughters are 13 and 10 and love to draw. The guide showed us how to sketch the buildings with the correct proportions and perspective and some cool tricks. The postcards came out great!
author: Ariella_H

title: Love that experience
text: It was an amazing work shop in the beautiful park with nice people. I really enjoy drawing the post card. Definitely recommend
author: Anna B
